name: jobs_frozen_noaudit
_notes: The frozen comparison: months 2025-08 to 2025-10, evaluation donors only. experiments_jobs.run refuses to run it until jobs_manifest.json has frozen: true.
Fill w_wage and seeker_noise from calibration before freezing. Do not edit any other market field after freezing; a change is a new versioned run.
bottomband and nolevel are omitted: the pilot showed bottomband is dominated and the level rule is almost never binding. Add them back only as named sensitivities.
llm_k5 and llm_q50 are skipped (not failed) until results/llm/jobs_frozen/recs.jsonl exists. Do not rename them after a run.
Leave temperature unset unless the pinned model accepts it; record the choice in the manifest either way.

llm: gpt-6-luna via the HUIT API Platform, reasoning_effort none, chosen 2026-11 for cost ($0.10/$0.50 per M tokens). The model page lists no dated snapshot, so record the model string the API returns (logged as model_returned) and the run dates.

protect: protected repairs for lower-wage seekers and for everyone (audit.ProtectedOracle, Todd's section 2). Added after the frozen run as a later analysis, per the protocol; logged as such. The LLM answers are cached.
notes: No-audit rerun of jobs_frozen (same markets, same saved GPT answers, no API calls), added 2026-11-22 because the frozen run predates the per-seeker blocker_count that experiments_jobs/contrast_T.py needs. Market IDs hash only the market spec, so they match jobs_frozen; no_audit outcomes are checked against jobs_frozen before T is reported.
